title: Memory Management
subtitle: Manage long-term memories, preferences, and facts stored by your AI.

empty.title: No memories yet
empty.description: As you interact with AI, it will automatically extract and remember facts about you.

clearAll.title: Clear all memories?
clearAll.description: This action is irreversible. AI will forget all personalized facts about you.

delete.title: Delete this memory?
delete.description: AI will no longer remember this information after deletion.
